Score multiply imputed LE8 inputs

Source: R/imputation.R
score_le8_imputed.Rd

Scores every completed data set from a multiple imputation and returns them stacked, with the imputation number in .imp. Methods for the result pool across imputations with Rubin's rules: summary() and, with dplyr, summarise() report pooled means with confidence intervals, and plot(type = "forest") draws pooled intervals.

Usage

score_le8_imputed(data, ...)

Arguments

data

A mids object from mice::mice() (for example, run with the settings from le8_imputation_setup()), or a data frame of stacked completed data sets with an integer .imp column numbering them from 1 (for example, from mice::complete(imputed, "long") or another imputation package). To impute and score in one call, use score_le8(impute = TRUE) instead.

...

Arguments passed to score_le8(), such as min_components.

Value

An essential8_imputed_scores object: the stacked scored data sets, a subclass of essential8_scores. Its summary(), summarise(), tidy(), and plot() methods account for the imputations.

Pooling

Each statistic is estimated in every imputed data set and combined with Rubin's rules. Means are pooled with total variance \(T = \bar{U} + (1 + 1/m) B\) and Barnard-Rubin degrees of freedom; the fraction of missing information (fmi) describes how much the imputations add to the uncertainty. Category percentages are pooled the same way. Standard deviations and quantiles are averaged across imputations, which describes the distribution but carries no interval.

See also

le8_imputation_setup()

Examples

adults <- read.csv(system.file(
  "extdata", "le8-adult-example.csv", package = "essential8"
))
adults <- adults[!startsWith(names(adults), "expected_")]
adults$non_hdl_cholesterol[c(2, 5)] <- NA

# Stacked completed data sets, as any imputation software might return.
completed <- function(imp, value) {
  out <- adults
  out$non_hdl_cholesterol[is.na(out$non_hdl_cholesterol)] <- value
  cbind(.imp = imp, out)
}
stacked <- rbind(completed(1L, 150), completed(2L, 170))
summary(score_le8_imputed(stacked))
#> LE8 scores: 10 participants (10 adult), pooled over 2 imputations
#> Diet method: mepa; min_components: 7
#> Composite score available for 10 of 10 (average over imputations).
#> 
#>                    n mean    95% CI  fmi   sd median
#> LE8 composite     10 48.1 27.2-68.9 0.19 28.2   49.1
#> Diet              10 51.0 22.9-79.1 0.19 38.1   50.0
#> Physical activity 10 60.0 35.2-84.8 0.19 33.7   70.0
#> Nicotine exposure 10 40.0 15.4-64.6 0.19 33.3   30.0
#> Sleep             10 55.0 28.5-81.5 0.19 36.0   55.0
#> BMI               10 46.5 20.2-72.8 0.19 35.7   50.0
#> Blood lipids      10 44.0 18.3-69.7 0.30 31.6   40.0
#> Blood glucose     10 46.0 22.6-69.4 0.19 31.7   50.0
#> Blood pressure    10 42.0 19.4-64.6 0.19 30.7   40.0
#> Means pooled with Rubin's rules; fmi = fraction of missing information.
#> 
#> Category (rows with a composite score):
#>            n percent    95% CI
#>   low      5   50.0% 13.1-86.9
#>   moderate 4   40.0%  3.9-76.1
#>   high     1   10.0%  0.0-32.1
